title: Sausage, Egg and Cheese English Muffins
description: Homemade breakfast sandwiches with seasoned sausage patties, a folded egg and melted cheddar on toasted English muffins.

image.alt: An English muffin sandwich with sausage, egg and cheese

steps.text: Divide the sausage into {count 4} pieces and press each into a thin patty a little wider than a muffin; they shrink as they cook.
Cook the patties in the skillet over medium heat until browned and cooked through with no pink in the middle, {time 4 min} per side. They should reach {temp 160F internal}. Move to a plate.
Toast the English muffins while the sausage cooks.

Wipe out the skillet and melt the butter over medium-low heat. Beat the eggs with the salt, pour them in and cook without stirring until almost set, {time 2-3 min}. Fold into quarters with a spatula and cut into {count 4} pieces.
Top each patty with a slice of cheese and a piece of egg, then return them to the pan for {time 30 sec} to melt the cheese. Sandwich in the toasted muffins.

notes: To freeze, wrap cooled sandwiches in foil or paper towels and freeze for up to 2 months. Microwave from frozen, wrapped in a paper towel, for 1½ to 2 minutes, turning once.
